[7.04s - 26.77s] [Speaker 0] a month from my phone and I'm gonna show you exactly how I did it. First head over to Amazon and find any kids popular coloring book. For example, this one right here is selling for $9.99 each and they've sold at least 12,000 copies. And if you do the math on that, that's a whole lot of money they're making. So here's how you're gonna capitalize on that. Take a screenshot or save an image of the coloring book like this, then head over to viewmax.io/mcp.
[26.77s - 40.17s] [Speaker 0] Copy this full link right here, then head over to connectors and paste it into Claude, and head over to Claude and type type in this exact prompt with the image of the coloring book. And in just a few moments, you have perfectly crafted coloring book pages just like these right here, which you then can upload to kdp.amazon,
[40.17s - 52.02s] [Speaker 0] which is a site that will print and ship all the books for you. And then you just sit back and collect 60% royalties on these. But if you want a more in-depth guide on how I do this for completely free, just comment Claude down below and I'll send it over to you for free.
